clean.title: Overhead Sign Structure Tubular Structural Frame Details - 1 (S-99.0, Sheet S-2 of 5)
clean.summary: Sheet S-2 of 5 of LADOT Standard Drawing S-99.0 gives frame details for the monotube cantilever sign. It shows the W6 x 12 sign support arms at 6' maximum spacing, the corner, arm splice and cantilever arm connection details, and plate sections B through G with bolt, slot and weld sizes. A design luminaire table lists LED count by sign length.
clean.notes:
This sheet has no numbered general notes. Notes and callouts on the sheet:
- Full depth 1/4" plate stiffener each side of web (clip corners for zinc drain).
- Luminaires and luminaire arms as required.
- Luminaire support arm if luminaire is required.
- Always provide 5/8" plate on sign support arm.
- W6 x 12 sign support arm at 6' MAX spacing.
- Extend top flange of horizontal member as shown or add 1/4" plate each side of web.
- Provide 1" dia. hole for conduit.
- 7/16" dia. hole for 5/8" dia. class 5 or greater bolt (not provided with luminaire).
- Cope bottom flange of W6 x 12.
- 11/16" dia. hole for 5/8" dia. x HS (high strength) bolt with nut and hardened washer, typ 4 places.
- 9/16" x 11/16" slots on 8" dia. bolt circle symmetrical about plate centerline.
- Install sign support arm in vertical position.
- 4 - 5/8" dia. x WA + 4-1/2" threaded rods (double nut each rod). 5/16" thick rectangular washers with 2 - 11/16" dia. holes. C6 x 10.5 with 4 - 11/16" x 1" slotted holes.
- 4 - 1/2" dia. x HS bolts with nut and hardened washer.
- Design luminaire: style MAQ-A120-7-LED-E1-SW-GM-DM-RD or equivalent, projected area 3.3 FT2, weight 60 lbs, LED count 2, 3 and 4 for sign lengths of 10'-20', 20'-30' and 30'-40'.
- General notes for the series are on sheet S-1.
clean.description:
Sheet S-2 of 5 of Standard Drawing S-99.0, tubular structural frame details for the overhead sign structure (monotube cantilever). The sheet is a large-format sheet with an elevation at upper left and numbered detail and section frames.

Upper left view (sign support frame with luminaire, referenced as Section A, E1, scale 1 1/2" = 1'-0", S-1): The sign face is drawn as a tall rectangle with SH as the total sign height and SH/2 above and below the horizontal centerline. W6 x 12 sign support arms are spaced at 6' MAX spacing and attach to the sign with a connection detail E7. The horizontal member at the top, a W6 x 12, is 4'-0" long, with a full depth 1/4" plate stiffener each side of web (clip corners for zinc drain). It sits 1'-2" above the top of sign. A 6" x 9" x 1/4" plate carries luminaires and luminaire support arms as required, shown at an angle. Fillet welds of 3/16" are shown. Reference circles: I7 (S-2, corner detail), I10 (S-2, arm splice detail), E7 (S-2), and section marker B (S-2) at the luminaire end. A VARIES dimension is shown at the arm connection. Section marker C (S-2) is cut at the base of the sign.

Design luminaire table: Style MAQ-A120-7-LED-E1-SW-GM-DM-RD or equivalent. Projected area 3.3 FT2. Weight 60 LBS. By structure number: Str No 1, sign length 10'-20', number of LED 2. Str No 2, sign length 20'-30', number of LED 3. Str No 3, sign length 30'-40', number of LED 4.

I7, Corner detail (scale 3" = 1'-0", S-2): A corner joint between two W6 x 12 members. Callouts: extend top flange of horizontal member as shown or add 1/4" plate each side of web, with 1/4" MAX and 1/4" MIN dimensions for the flange extension, provide 1" dia. hole for conduit, full depth 1/4" plate stiffener each side of web (clip corners for zinc drain), 1" dia. cope, CJP (complete joint penetration) weld, backgouge, and 3/16" fillet welds.

I10, Arm splice detail (scale 3" = 1'-0", S-2): Two sign support arms joined end to end with a plate. Callouts: luminaire support arm if luminaire is required, always provide 5/8" plate on sign support arm, sign support arm, with bolts and nuts at the splice plate, and section marker D (S-2).

I14, Section B (scale 3" = 1'-0", S-2): Plan of the luminaire plate on the W6 x 12 arm. A 6" x 9" x 1/4" plate with 7/16" dia. holes for 5/8" dia. class 5 or greater bolt (not provided with luminaire), four holes at 1-3/4" and 5" dimensions, 3-3/8" hole spacing, 1" CL TYP, 8-3/4" overall dimension, cope bottom flange of W6 x 12, 1" dia. hole and a 3/16" weld.

E13, Section C (scale 3" = 1'-0", S-2): End of the W6 x 12 sign support arm capped by a 1/2" plate sign support. Dimensions 1/2", 6-1/2", 2-1/2", 5" plate height (2-1/2" each side of the centerline) and 3/16" welds (5/32" at G).

E7, Cantilever arm connection (scale 3" = 1'-0", S-2): Elevation showing the C6 x 10.5 channel carrying the sign, with 5/8" dia. x (Wa + 4-1/2") threaded rod, typ, 1-1/2" dimension, Wa + 5/8" internal width, 4 - 1/2" dia. x HS bolts with nut and hardened washer at the plate to the W6 x 12 sign support arm, and a 3" dimension. Reference markers F, E and G (S-2).

A1, Section D (scale 3" = 1'-0", S-2): Plate with four 11/16" dia. holes for 5/8" dia. x HS bolt with nut and hardened washer, typ 4 places, 1" dia. hole for conduit, plate size 5/8" thick with 1-1/4" TYP edge, dimensions 1-1/4", 5", 2" and 2-1/2", and 3/16" welds (5/32" at G).

A5, Section E (scale 3" = 1'-0", S-2): Install sign support arm in vertical position. 1/2" thick plate, 8" x 8" plate, 8" dia. bolt circle, 45 degree angle, 3/16" weld, 9/16" x 11/16" slots on 8" dia. bolt circle symmetrical about plate centerline (enlarged detail shown).

A9, Section F (scale 3" = 1'-0", S-2): 1/2" thick plate, 8" x 8", C6 x 10.5, sign support arm, 8" dia. bolt circle at 45 degrees, 9/16" x 11/16" slots symmetrical about plate centerline, 1" dia. hole for conduit, 1/4" weld TYP, 1-1/2" dimension.

A13, Section G (scale 3" = 1'-0", S-2): The C6 x 10.5 with 4 - 11/16" x 1" slotted holes, 4 - 5/8" dia. x WA + 4-1/2" threaded rods (double nut each rod), 5/16" thick rectangular washers with 2 - 11/16" dia. holes, sign support arm, 2" edge dimension, 4-1/4" overall width, 3" between the rod rows, 1-1/2" dimension and a 1/4" weld.

clean.title: Overhead Sign Structure Tubular Structural Frame Details - 2 (S-99.0, Sheet S-3 of 5)
clean.summary: Sheet S-3 of 5 of LADOT Standard Drawing S-99.0 shows the arm-to-post connection for the monotube cantilever sign, with a flange plate weld detail, Sections A and B, and a three-row connection table giving plate size, bolt count and spacing. It also shows the arm cap and post cap details with their cap ring sections.
clean.notes:
This sheet has no numbered general notes. Notes and callouts on the sheet:
- (3) - 1/2" diameter holes to match 3/8" diameter stainless steel bolts.
- 6" dia hole through flange plates and post wall.
- NH = number of bolts in horizontal row. NV = number of bolts in vertical column. HS = spacing of bolts in horizontal row. VS = spacing of bolts in vertical column.
- Arm cap: drill and tap for (4) - 3/8" dia. 1" hex head stainless steel bolts. Post cap ring - 1" x 0.5". Arm cap ring - 1" x 0.5". 3/8" thick plate. Note: see tube selection table on sheet S-1 for ta.
- Post cap: cap shall be 1/8" convex at center to shed water. Drill and tap for (3) - 3/8" dia. 1" hex head stainless steel bolts. Note: see tube selection table on sheet S-1 for tp.
- Flange plate weld detail: CJP, 3/8" and 3/16" and 7/16" welds, 1" x 1/4" backing ring, "db" dia HS bolt.
- General notes for the series are on sheet S-1.
clean.description:
Sheet S-3 of 5 of Standard Drawing S-99.0, tubular structural frame details for the overhead sign structure (monotube cantilever), with arm-to-post connection, a connection table, cap details and sections.

I1, Arm-to-post connection (scale 1" = 1'-0", S-1): Elevation of the square tube arm (width Wa) meeting a round post of diameter Dp through a pair of flange plates. Two horizontal connection plates extend from the flange plate into the post, spaced Wb apart (plate thickness tr noted at the top). Dp is dimensioned across the post at the bottom. Callouts: (3) - 1/2" diameter holes to match 3/8" diameter stainless steel bolts (at the post top, with E7 on S-3 pointing to the post cap), 7/16" fillet welds (TYP) at the connection plates, 7/16" weld at the flange plate. Reference markers: I5 (S-3, flange plate weld detail), A (S-3, Section A), B (S-3, Section B), E7 (S-3).

I5, Flange plate weld detail (NTS): Enlarged weld between the flange plates (two thick plates side by side), the arm wall, the connection plate and a high strength bolt. Callouts: flange plate, "db" dia HS bolt, connection plate, arm, 1" x 1/4" backing ring, CJP (complete joint penetration) groove weld with a 3/8" size, and 7/16" and 3/16" fillet welds.

I9, Section A (scale 1" = 1'-0", S-3): Face view of the flange plate. The plate is Wf wide and Wf high, with NH bolts @ HS across the top and bottom rows, NV bolts @ VS up the vertical columns, and edge distance E on every side. The arm outline of Wa x Wa with rounded corners sits inside the bolt pattern. A 6" dia. hole is cut through the flange plates and post wall at the center.

I13, Section B (scale 1" = 1'-0", S-3): Plan section through the arm-to-post connection. The arm (width Wa) with flange plate thickness tf and a 2" dimension joins the post, which is wrapped by a U-shaped connection plate with thickness tb and radius dimension Wr. 3/8" welds (TYP) are noted.

E1, Arm-to-post connection table (NTS, S-3): Columns Structure No, Wf, tf, NH, HS, NV, VS, Wb, tb, Wr, tr, db, E.
Structure 1: Wf 2'-2", tf 2", NH 5, HS 5-1/2", NV 3, VS 5-1/2", Wb 1'-4", tb 1/2", Wr 4", tr 1", db 1", E 2".
Structure 2: Wf 2'-8", tf 2", NH 7, HS 4-1/2", NV 5, VS 4-1/2", Wb 1'-10", tb 1/2", Wr 4", tr 1", db 1", E 2-1/2".
Structure 3: Wf 3'-2", tf 2", NH 9, HS 4-1/4", NV 7, VS 4-1/4", Wb 2'-4", tb 1/2", Wr 4", tr 1", db 1", E 2".
Legend: NH = number of bolts in horizontal row. NV = number of bolts in vertical column. HS = spacing of bolts in horizontal row. VS = spacing of bolts in vertical column.

A1, Arm cap detail (scale 3" = 1'-0", S-1): Side section of the cap plate across the arm width Wa, 3/8" thick plate, with a post cap ring 1" x 0.5" below it (dimensions 3/4" and 1"), arm wall thickness ta, drill and tap for (4) - 3/8" dia. 1" hex head stainless steel bolts, and a 3/16" fillet weld. Section marker D (S-3). Note: see tube selection table on sheet S-1 for ta.

E7, Post cap detail (scale 3" = 1'-0", S-3): Side section of the cap plate across the post diameter Dp. The cap shall be 1/8" convex at center to shed water. 3/8" thick plate, with a post cap ring 1" x 0.5" below it (dimensions 3/4" and 1"), post wall thickness tp, drill and tap for (3) - 3/8" dia. 1" hex head stainless steel bolts, and a 3/16" fillet weld. Section marker C (S-3). Note: see tube selection table on sheet S-1 for tp.

A6, Section D (scale 3" = 1'-0", S-3): Plan of the arm cap ring, rounded square outline, with the arm wall and an arm cap ring 1" x 0.5" inside it, and drill and tap for (4) - 3/8" dia. 1" hex head stainless steel bolts, one at each side.

E12, Section C (scale 3" = 1'-0", S-3): Plan of the post cap ring, circular, showing the post wall and a post cap ring 1" x 0.5" inside it, with drill and tap for (3) - 3/8" dia. 1" hex head stainless steel bolts at 120 degree spacing.

clean.title: Overhead Sign Structure Tubular Base Plate and Anchorage Details (S-99.0, Sheet S-4 of 5)
clean.summary: Sheet S-4 of 5 of LADOT Standard Drawing S-99.0 gives the base plate and anchorage details for the monotube cantilever sign. It includes handhole and cover plate details, base plate and anchor plate plans, a base plate table for three structure sizes, conduit hub detail, post-to-base weld, and anchor rod template assembly 6'-2" long.
clean.notes:
This sheet has no numbered general notes. Notes and callouts on the sheet:
- Note: see base plate table for base plate and anchor bolt information.
- "N" holes. Hole dia. = bolt dia. "DAR" + 1/4".
- Locate anchor rod hole here (arm centerline).
- Holes for anchor rods. Hole locations to match base plate. Hole dia. = DB + 1/16".
- Anchor plate thickness = 1-1/2" (not galvanized).
- "DAR" dia. anchor rod with 4 nuts and 4 hardened washers.
- 1" x 3" handhole reinforcement. Drill and tap frame for 1/4" x 1" stainless steel screws.
- Drill 5/16" dia. holes in cover. 3/16" thick cover plate.
- 2" conduit for post and 3/4" conduit for arm.
- Forged steel 1/1/2" NPT [printed as shown] class 3000 threaded half coupling. Inside edge of conduit hub shall be smooth.
- Provide threaded insert plug at locations where conduit is not installed.
- 1-1/4" dia. galvanizing drain hole, typ, 1/4" clear of backing ring.
- General notes for the series are on sheet S-1.
clean.description:
Sheet S-4 of 5 of Standard Drawing S-99.0, tubular base plate and anchorage details for the overhead sign structure (monotube cantilever).

J1, Handhole details (scale 3" = 1'-0", S-1): Face view of a handhole cut in the post (post diameter Dp). The opening is an obround 6" wide by 7-1/2" high with R=3" ends, surrounded by a 1" x 3" handhole reinforcement ring, with the frame drilled and tapped for 1/4" x 1" stainless steel screws (four screw locations). A 3/8" dimension is shown on the ring. Section marker A (S-4) is cut through the handhole.

H1, Handhole cover plate (scale 3" = 1'-0", S-4): An obround cover 6" wide by 7-1/2" high with R=3" ends, 3/16" thick cover plate, with 5/16" dia. holes drilled in the cover (four holes).

J6, Base plate details (scale 3/4" = 1'-0", S-5): Plan of the base plate, showing the post tube centered in a round base plate of diameter Dbp with a bolt circle of diameter Dbc. Dh is the center hole diameter and Dp the post tube diameter. "N" holes, hole dia. = bolt dia. "DAR" + 1/4", are spaced at angle (symbol phi) TYP around the circle, measured from the arm side. The arm centerline (ARM CL) is marked and a callout says locate anchor rod hole here. Base plate thickness = tbp. Reference marker A1 (S-4) points to the post-to-base-plate weld. Note: see base plate table for base plate and anchor bolt information.

G6, Anchor plate details (scale 3/4" = 1'-0", S-5): Plan of the anchor plate, a round ring with bolt circle diameter Dbc and a 2-1/4" and 4" edge dimension. Holes for anchor rods, hole locations to match base plate, hole dia. = DB + 1/16". Anchor plate thickness = 1-1/2" (not galvanized).

J11, Base plate table (NTS, S-4): Columns Structure No, Dbp, tbp, Dh, Dbc, N, phi (degrees), DAR.
Structure 1: Dbp 2'-9", tbp 2-3/4", Dh 6", Dbc 2'-4", N 8, phi 45, DAR 2-1/2".
Structure 2: Dbp 3'-4", tbp 2-3/4", Dh 6", Dbc 2'-10", N 12, phi 30, DAR 2-1/2".
Structure 3: Dbp 3'-10", tbp 2-3/4", Dh 6", Dbc 3'-4", N 16, phi 22.5, DAR 2-1/2".

G11, Hub detail (scale 3" = 1'-0", S-1): Side section of the post wall (thickness tp) with a conduit hub. A forged steel threaded half coupling is welded to the post wall flush with the inside. Callouts: 2" conduit for post and 3/4" conduit for arm, 3/16" fillet weld, a (tp - 1/8") dimension, and a 1/2" dimension. Forged steel 1/1/2" NPT [printed as shown] class 3000 threaded half coupling. Inside edge of conduit hub shall be smooth. Provide threaded insert plug at locations where conduit is not installed.

D1, Section A (scale 3" = 1'-0", S-4): Plan of the round post tube, which is shown open at the lower left. The two ends of the rolled tube wall meet two hatched bars about 1" apart (1" dimension), with a 2-3/8" dimension and a 5/8" dimension, and a CJP weld callout at the right end.

A1, Post to base plate connection detail (NTS, S-4): Section through the post wall on the base plate. Callouts: post, 1" x 3/16" backing ring, 3/16" fillet weld, CJP weld with a 3/8" size and 3/8" dimension, base plate, and 1-1/4" dia. galvanizing drain hole, typ, 1/4" clear of backing ring.

A6, Anchor bolt template assembly (scale 3" = 1'-0", S-5): Elevation of one anchor rod. "DAR" dia. anchor rod with 4 nuts and 4 hardened washers. A top nut sits on the base plate and a bearing nut below it, with an 8" dimension for the thread/rod projection above the base plate. Top of concrete pedestal is 2-1/2" NOM, 3" MAX below the base plate. The top thread length and rod projection is 8", the total anchor rod length is 6'-2", and the bottom thread length is 8" BTM THREAD at the anchor plate, which has nuts above and below it.

clean.summary: Sheet S-5 of 5 of LADOT Standard Drawing S-99.0 shows the round CIDH pile foundation for the monotube cantilever sign, with an elevation of the reinforcing cage, a plan section with 3 inch minimum clear and 1'-3-3/4" hoop lap, and a pile table giving diameter, length, bar counts and hoops for three structure sizes (4'-0" to 5'-0" diameter, 13'-6" to 18'-0" long).
clean.notes:
This sheet has no numbered general notes. Notes and callouts on the sheet:
- Final grade slope shall not exceed 1:2.5 within 5'-0" of support centerline (CL).
- CL post = CL shaft.
- Double ties at top.
- Vertical reinforcement (see table). Transverse reinforcement (see table).
- 2" dia conduit.
- Lap 1'-3-3/4" for the transverse reinforcement. 3" CL. MIN. (clear minimum) cover.
- This CL parallel to sign face.
- General notes for the series are on sheet S-1.
clean.description:
Sheet S-5 of 5 of Standard Drawing S-99.0, round pedestal pile foundation for the overhead sign structure (monotube cantilever).

D1, Round pedestal pile foundation (scale 3/4" = 1'-0", S-1): Elevation of a cast-in-drilled-hole (CIDH) pile drawn with break lines, with its vertical reinforcement and transverse reinforcement shown as a grid. The pile centerline coincides with the post centerline (CL post = CL shaft). The post stands on a base plate on four anchor rods at the top of the pile, with the pile top up to 3" MAX above final grade. Callouts: final grade slope shall not exceed 1:2.5 within 5'-0" of support CL, double ties at top, vertical reinforcement (see table), transverse reinforcement (see table), 2" dia conduit curving out of the pile near the top, and a 3" dimension from the bottom of the reinforcing cage to the bottom of the pile. PILE LENGTH is dimensioned from final grade to the bottom of the pile. Reference markers: A6 (S-4, anchor bolt template assembly), J6 (S-4, base plate details), G6 (S-4, anchor plate details, shown at the bottom anchor plate with nuts), and Section A (S-5).

I7, Section A (scale 3/4" = 1'-0", S-5): Plan of the round pile, showing pile diameter, a ring of equally spaced vertical bars (about 16 dots shown) inside the circular transverse reinforcement. The transverse hoop is shown with a lap of 1'-3-3/4". A 3" CL. MIN. (clear minimum) dimension is given from the bar to the pile edge. Callouts: vertical reinforcement (see table), transverse reinforcement (see table), this centerline parallel to sign face.

A1, Pile foundation table (NTS, S-5): Columns Structure No, CIDH pile (pile dia, pile length), vertical reinforcement (total, bar size), hoops (bar size, spacing).
Structure 1: pile dia 4'-0", pile length 13'-6", 20 vertical bars, bar size #9, hoops #4 at 6".
Structure 2: pile dia 4'-0", pile length 15'-0", 20 vertical bars, bar size #9, hoops #4 at 6".
Structure 3: pile dia 5'-0", pile length 18'-0", 28 vertical bars, bar size #9, hoops #4 at 6".

clean.title: Backplates (Standard Drawing S-77.8A)
clean.summary: Standard drawing S-77.8A, dated October 20, 2025, shows the outlines of traffic signal backplates for 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 section heads and cluster heads. Each has a 5 inch border (A), 2 inch corner radius (R) and a 2 inch yellow retroreflective strip. Notes set the 1/8 inch ABS material, flange, finish, impact test and Type XI retroreflective sheeting requirements.
clean.notes:
1. The width dimension, "A", should be 5" typical (TYP.) and the corner radius dimension, "R", should be 2" TYP. The backplate shall have a nominal thickness of 1/8". All outside and inside edges shall be formed with a 1/2" to 5/8" flange (inside dimension), turned away from the front surface.
2. For all manufactured signal heads, backplates shall be designed so as to show no background light between the backplate and the head. The fabrication shall be vacuum formed as one piece with a black lusterless, haircell finish on the front side. All surfaces shall be flat and straight without blisters, buckling or warping. Flanges shall be straight, uniform and have a consistent flange dimension throughout.
3. The backplate material shall be compounded from virgin ABS containing 60% styrene, 20% rubber and 20% acrylic. It shall contain ultra violet inhibitors and stabilizers for protection against ultra violet degradation. The backplate must meet a falling dart impact test of 16 ft/lb.
4. The internal shapes and dimensions shall match various manufactured signal heads.
5. Retroreflective sheeting must be Type XI and comply with ASTM D4956. Retroreflective sheeting must have Class 1, 3, or 4 adhesive backing. The adhesive backing must be pressure sensitive and fungus resistant. Retroreflective sheeting must be applied at the fabrication plant under the retroreflective sheeting manufacturer's instruction without appreciable stretching, tearing or other damage.

Callout: 2-inch yellow retroreflective strip.
clean.description:
Plan view (front view) of the traffic signal backplate outlines, drawn as nine rounded rectangles each with a dashed inner rectangle (the signal head footprint) and dashed circles (the signal lenses). Each backplate has an inner line showing the flange and a 2-inch yellow retroreflective strip along the border. Dimension A TYP. is the border width on all sides and R TYP. is the corner radius.

Left column, top to bottom: a narrow vertical backplate for a 3-section head with small lenses, a vertical backplate for a 2-section head, a near-square backplate for a 1-section head, and a tall backplate for a 5-section head in which three smaller lenses are above two larger lenses (the plate outline steps wider at the larger lenses).
Middle column: a vertical backplate for a 3-section head with larger lenses, and a larger backplate with a 5-light cluster (one lens on top over two rows of two).
Right columns: a vertical backplate for a 4-section head, a vertical backplate for a 5-section head, and a squarer backplate for a 3-section cluster head with two lenses over one.

Dimensions are given only as letters: A is the width of the border (5" typ. per note 1) and R is the corner radius (2" typ. per note 1). The 2-inch yellow retroreflective strip is called out on the border of the backplates.

clean.summary: Sheet 1 of 2 of standard drawing S-486.0 (March 4, 2005) for street name signs hung from traffic signal mast arms. Notes give legend sizes, colors (white on blue for street names, white on green for ramps), reflectivity and the 96 inch length limit.
clean.notes:

1. Legend size: 8" upper case, 6" lower case, Series "E" letters; 11-1/4" x 12-3/4" one-line arrow.
2. Color: white legend, blue background.

clean.title: Mast Arm Street Name Sign Bracket Type 1 (S-457.0)
clean.summary: Standard drawing S-457.0 (approved 12-1-88) for the Type 1 mast arm street name sign bracket in two versions: the M10J-OCB250AL adjustable length swing bracket (13-3/8 to 17-7/8 inches) and the M10J-OCB250FL fixed length bracket (5-1/2 inches). It lists the 13 numbered stainless steel and aluminum components and shows typical installation of a Main St sign on a mast arm, banded with 3/4 inch type 201 stainless steel banding.
clean.notes:
Component legend (circled numbers):
(1) Pivotal upper bracket.
(2) 1" x 1/4" slot for double strapping to electrolier mast arm. Cat. No. M2G-34S(HD) .032" x 1/4" heavy duty stainless steel strap with Cat. No. M2G-34B(HD) buckle recommended.
(3) 1/2"-13 x 1-1/2" stainless steel hex head bolt with stainless steel hex lock nut and 1/16" stainless steel washer (both sides). Allows upper bracket to pivot and align with electrolier mast arm. Do not tighten past nut locking feature for pivot action to be operational.
(4) 5-1/2" overall length fixed length sign bracket.
(5) Stainless steel dampener spring (removable).
(6) Stainless steel hex lock nut with 1/16" stainless steel washer. Do not tighten, it binds hinges.
(7) 1" O.D. axle housing.
(8) 1/2"-13 x 4" stainless steel hex head bolt with 1/16" stainless steel washer. Do not tighten lock nut past locking feature, it binds hinges.
(9) Oilite bushing.
(10) Sign mounting sets, consisting of two each 5/16"-18 x 1" stainless steel hex head bolt with stainless steel hex lock nut. Two holes on 1-1/2" centers provide positive lock sign mounting to bracket.
(11) 7-3/4" overall length upper adjustable sign bracket section.
(12) 9" overall length lower adjustable sign bracket section, including axle housing (8" overall length to top of axle housing).
(13) 1/2"-13 x 1-1/2" stainless steel hex bolt with stainless steel hex lock nut and 1/16" stainless steel washers (both sides). Loosen lock nut, adjust bracket teeth to level sign.

Notes:
1. Brackets available from: Hawkins Traffic Safety Supply, 1255 Eastshore Highway, Berkeley, CA 94710, (415) 525-4040.
2. If another sign is installed on the mast arm next to the signal head, the street name sign shall be installed with 12" clearance to the edge of that sign.
3. Sign bracket shall be attached to mast arm with 3/4" wide type 201 stainless steel sign banding secured with a banding buckle. Banding shall be 0.020" thick double banded or 0.030" thick single banded.

Drawing labels: Allows length adjustment of 4-1/2". 17-7/8" fully extend overall length. 13-3/8" fully closed overall length.
clean.description:
Elevation views of the M10J-OCB250AL adjustable length swing sign bracket (all aluminum 6061T6 alloy and stainless steel components), left side of sheet: Two side elevations. The first is shown fully extended, 17-7/8" overall length, and the second is fully closed, 13-3/8" overall length. At the top is a U-shaped upper bracket 2-1/2" wide with 1/4" leg thickness and 1/2" leg height, held with a bolt and nut. A 2-1/4" dimension is shown from the top of the pivot plate to the bolt. The serrated (toothed) adjustment section allows a length adjustment of 4-1/2". Dimensions 2" and 3/8" are given at the bottom near the 1" axle housing, with 3/8" from the bottom of the sign mounting hole to the bottom of the bracket. The sign is shown dashed at the bottom. Circled numbers 11 and 12 mark the upper and lower adjustable sections.

Isometric view of the adjustable bracket: shows the pivotal upper bracket (1) with two 1" x 1/4" slots (2) and a 2-1/2" width, bolt (3), upper adjustable section (11), lower adjustable section (12) with a slot and bolt (13), dampener spring (5), lock nut (6), axle housing (7), bolt (8), oilite bushings (9), and two sign mounting bolts (10). Dimensions at the bottom: 1-1/2" bolt hole spacing, 3/8" and 2-1/2" widths.

M10J-OCB250FL fixed length non-adjustable swing sign bracket (all aluminum 6061T6 alloy and stainless steel components), center of sheet: A side elevation, 5-1/2" overall height, with the 2-1/2" wide U-shaped upper bracket (1/4" and 1-1/2" dimensions), bolt (3) with a 2-1/4" dimension, fixed bracket (4), dampener spring (5), axle housing (7), bolt (8) and sign mounting bolt (10) with 2" and 3/8" dimensions, and a note 3/8" from bottom of sign mounting hole to bottom of bracket. An isometric shows the same parts with 2-1/2" and 3/8" widths and 1-1/2" hole spacing. An Extension Straps detail at upper right shows the strap plate with 1/2" dia. holes, 1/2" edge distances, 3-1/2" hole spacing, 1/8" thickness and 2-1/2" width.

Typical installation elevation (lower center): A signal pole with a mast arm and a signal head (centerline marked), with a "Main St" street name sign hanging from the mast arm by two brackets. The signal head is 30" from the sign, and the sign length L has L/4 overhang each side beyond the brackets (brackets spaced L/2 apart). Labels: M10J-OCB250AL Bracket and M10J-OCB250FL Bracket.

clean.title: Electric Train and Bus Warning Sign
clean.summary: Fiber optic electric warning signs showing a train with the word TRAIN or a bus with the word BUS, drawing S-58.23, approved June 26, 2008. The signs are yellow on black and come in a 24 inch by 30 inch face and a 16.25 inch by 14.5 inch pedestrian head size. A table gives the letter and symbol spacing, and 11 notes cover fiber optic bundles, the FHWA sign book, drain holes and mounting.
clean.notes:
1. Messages shall be formed by rows of fiber optic glass bundles.
2. Dual rows of fiber optic bundles shall be used to form the word "TRAIN". Letters in the bus warning sign message shall have a brush stroke of 1-inch. Bus symbol and letters shall also conform to the latest edition of the FHWA Standard Highway Signs book.
3. The front view of the train or bus shall be solid formed by rows of fiber optic glass bundles.
4. The color of the messages shall be yellow. The sign background shall be black.
5. Fiber optic glass bundles shall alternate between two or more lamp sources. In the event of a lamp failure, the sign shall continue to display a readable and discernable message.
6. Sign housing shall be equipped with four (4) 3/16" drain holes at the bottom.
7. The visor enclosure shall be fastened securely to the front frame of the sign.
8. Housing shall contain 4 1/2" x 4 1/2" x 1/4" reinforcement plate located on the top and bottom for use with the Pelco Astro Sign-Brac installation.
9. Refer to Std. Dwg. No. S-63.1.4 for the mounting assembly (T=46", L=29").
10. Sign shall conform to LADOT Specification No. 82-049-03.
11. For housing description see LADOT Std. Dwg. No. S-58.21.
Table footnote: * Five 1" spaces to delineate the rail road track.

Horizontal spacing G and H are shown at the letters T, R, A, I, N.

Table of dimensions for the train sign: A = 1.5". B = 13". *C = 5". D = 3". E = 6". F = 1.5". G = 2.094". H = 2.688". Footnote: * Five 1" spaces to delineate the rail road track.

Pedestrian head sign, train (not to scale): A rounded rectangle 16.25" wide by 14.5" high with the train symbol 8.3" wide and 12.5" tall, with 1" top and 1" bottom margins.

Pedestrian head sign, bus: A rounded rectangle 16.25" wide by 14.5" high with the dotted bus symbol 13" wide, 1.625" side margins and 12.5" tall, with 1" top and 1" bottom margins.

Visor enclosure: Isometric visor hood with dimensions drawn as 24', 17', 30' and 11', the same 24" wide, 30" tall hood that tapers from 17" to 11" deep seen on the R3-5 sign. The lower corners have a 2" Rad. callout.

clean.title: Transit Priority Unit Cabinet Details
clean.summary: Wiring of the 12-position dual barrier strip TB0 in the transit priority unit cabinet, drawing S-70.3A, sheet 4 of 6. It shows which terminals take the ground and drain wires, which go to pins D, E, J and K of the input file slot 10 backplanes, and the detector lead-in cable (DLC) of 1 pair #12 AWG. One note says all connections shall be soldered.
clean.notes:
1. All connections shall be soldered.
* Second harness to input file J is only required for 3 and 4 loop installation.
Callouts: B1 harness, B2 harness (file I slot 10 backplane); B3 harness, B4 harness (file J slot 10 backplane)*; GROUND; TO PIN D, E, J, K; NOT USED; DRAIN WIRES; DLC (1-pair #12 AWG); TB0.
clean.description:
12-position dual barrier strip TB0: A horizontal strip with 12 terminal positions, each with a top and bottom lug. Positions 1 to 3 are labeled NOT USED. Position 4 is GROUND and receives the DRAIN WIRES from the four cables. Positions 5 and 6 go TO PIN D and TO PIN E on the B1 harness (File I slot 10 backplane). Positions 7 and 8 go TO PIN J and TO PIN K on the B2 harness (File I slot 10 backplane). Positions 9 and 10 go TO PIN D and TO PIN E on the B3 harness (File J slot 10 backplane)*. Positions 11 and 12 go TO PIN J and TO PIN K on the B4 harness (File J slot 10 backplane)*.

Below the strip each pair of terminals is connected by a twisted pair to a cable end labeled B1, B2, B3* and B4*. These are the loop detector lead-in cables, labeled DLC (1-pair #12 AWG).

Footnote: * Second harness to input file J is only required for 3 and 4 loop installation.

clean.summary: Terminal panel and C20 connector of the transit priority unit, drawing S-70.3A, sheet 6 of 6. A 5.0 inch by 7.0 inch white aluminum panel carries barrier strips CTB-4 and CTB-5 and a 6 foot C20 harness runs to the C20S port of the 2070 controller. 1. Provide two (2) 1/4" mounting holes centered 0.325" from top and bottom edges.
2. All connections shall be soldered.

clean.title: Pedestrian Barricade
clean.summary: Pedestrian barricade, drawing S-454.2, approved June 26, 2008. A galvanized 1-1/2 inch nominal pipe railing 4 feet 6 inches high with 1 foot radius corners carries signs R9-3a and R9-3b, and posts are 6 feet apart and anchored with a 5 inch square, 1/2 inch base plate and four 1/2 inch bolts.
clean.notes:
1. Pipe post to be set 1'-6" back from face of curb unless otherwise specified.
2. For minimum pipe diameters and wall thickness refer to ASTM A6M.
3. Use left, right or double arrow on sign as needed.
clean.description:
Elevation of barricade: A pipe railing with two vertical posts and three horizontal 1-1/2" nominal pipe rails, bent with 1'-0" R corners at the top. The overall height above the top of sidewalk is 4'-6". The rails are spaced 1'-3" below the top rail and another 1'-3" below that. The posts are 6'-0" apart (Typical). Signs R9-3a & R9-3b, 18" x 24" (a no pedestrian symbol in a circle with slash, above the words USE CROSSWALK and an arrow) are mounted between the upper rails. Callouts: 1-1/2" Nominal pipe size galvanized Standard pipe, See Post Anchorage Detail, Top of sidewalk.

Post Anchorage Detail, elevation: A pipe post set in a threaded pipe collar on a 1/2" base plate fastened with 1/2" x 2-1/2" bolts (4) to a PCC sidewalk.

Post Anchorage Detail, plan: A 5" square base plate on a 5" bolt circle with 9/16" dia. holes (4) at the corners and 1/2" dia. expansion anchors (4).
